title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Security Deposit: Collection and Disposition
content:
**Admission agreement, deposit clause — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.**

**Clause in force.** A deposit is collected only while the agreement is pending admission or active, and never from a resident whose stay is billed to Medicare Part A or Medicaid, including Medicaid pending. The agreement's status is read on the system record before a deposit is received.

**Retired clauses.**
- The clause "A refundable security deposit of the security deposit days times the tier's daily rate in effect on the admission date is collected on a private-pay agreement." is **no longer in force** as written. It is superseded by the current basis: a refundable security deposit of the security deposit days times the tier's daily rate in effect on the admission date is collected on a private-pay agreement at admission; on an agreement that records no conversion to another payer source, the additional deposit owed after a move to a room of another tier is figured by the additional-deposit rule, and on an agreement that records a conversion and is active again, the resumption deposit owed once private-pay billing resumes is figured by the resumption-deposit rule; every other deposit stays under the admission rule.
- The clause "Within the deposit disposition days after discharge, or after conversion to a payer source for which no deposit may be held, the deposit is applied to the agreement's open balance and any remainder is refunded to the resident, the designated representative, or the estate after a death." is **no longer in force** as written. It is superseded by the current basis: within the deposit disposition days after discharge, or after conversion to a payer source for which no deposit may be held, the deposit is applied to the agreement's open balance and any remainder is refunded to the resident, the designated representative, or the estate after a death; where private-pay billing resumes on the agreement within those days and the deposit has not yet been disposed of, the deposit stays on the agreement and counts toward the resumption deposit, and only in that case.

**The admission deposit as figured.** The security deposit days (the tier's deposit terms) times the tier's daily rate in effect on the admission date, rounded to the cent. *Hypothetical:* an admission to the Private Secure Memory Care Room on a day its 449.00 rate was in effect: 30 days times 449.00 is 13,470.00.

**Effects.** A deposit received raises the deposit held for the agreement. A deposit applied to the balance is posted as a payment from the security deposit against the open charges; a refunded deposit is paid to its payee.

superseded_clauses: A refundable security deposit of the security deposit days times the tier's daily rate in effect on the admission date is collected on a private-pay agreement.

Within the deposit disposition days after discharge, or after conversion to a payer source for which no deposit may be held, the deposit is applied to the agreement's open balance and any remainder is refunded to the resident, the designated representative, or the estate after a death.
